The available regulatory sources do not provide enough information to answer when a Cosmetic Product Ingredient Statement should be filed for a new tinted lip balm.  

21 CFR 700.3(b) [2] defines "cosmetic product" as a finished cosmetic whose manufacture has been completed and does not specify any filing deadline or requirement for submitting a Cosmetic Product Ingredient Statement.  
21 CFR 720.9 [1] states that the filing of Form FDA 2512 or assignment of a number to the statement does not denote approval by the FDA and that any representation implying official approval due to such filing is misleading; it provides no information on when the statement must be filed.
